checkedAlternates.risk: School nurses are common, so a nurse can plausibly be placed in the school group.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The group labels name the usual workplace; for a nurse that is a hospital, and moving the nurse to the school leaves the hospital row one short with no candidate to fill it.

checkedAlternates.risk: School canteens employ cooks, so a chef could be read into the school group.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The everyday reading of "chef" is a restaurant kitchen, and the restaurant row needs all four of its items.

checkedAlternates.risk: Air ambulance and medical evacuation pilots connect a pilot to a hospital.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The ordinary reading of a pilot is an airline pilot, and the airplane is the only workplace with a single job in the set.

authorReview.notes: This family leans on "usual workplace" rather than an exclusive one, which is the same interpretive style as the At Home and Sports families already released.

blindPlaytest.notes: The nurse is the item to watch. If blind testers split on it, replace the nurse with a surgeon.
